morbi.headline: Mixed margin signals emerge for Morbi ceramic units amid fluctuating gas and propane prices.
what_changed: Morbi ceramic industry secured a Rs 5 discount on natural gas prices.
Propane gas prices surged by Rs 7,300 per metric tonne, creating an input-cost shock.
Large suspicious stock of imported coal was discovered in a closed local unit.
stress_signals: Propane price hike of Rs 7,300/tonne threatens immediate margin pressure for vitrified and wall tile manufacturing kilns [2f37d34283cf]
Suspicious stock of imported coal found in a closed factory in Rafaleshwar GIDC raises operational/compliance concerns [f675c060fa53]
improvement_signals: Natural gas prices dropped from Rs 82 following a Rs 5 discount for the Morbi ceramic industry [279312659941]
Kajaria Ceramics beat Q2 2026 sales and profit revenue estimates [c28b87e03125]
what_to_watch: Effective dates, full pricing structures, and supplier specifics for the natural gas price discount.
Margin impact on propane-dependent vitrified and wall tile manufacturers.
Further legal or operational details regarding the coal stock seized at Rafaleshwar GIDC.

surat.headline: Surat faces severe power disruptions, festive liquidity stress, and contradictory diamond demand trends.
what_changed: Textile mills hit by power cuts and electricity tariff hikes, threatening an estimated Rs 300 crore weekly output loss across Gujarat.
Diamond cluster experiences acute pre-Diwali payment defaults, artisan wage disputes, and lingering sluggishness at the Surat Diamond Bourse.
Contradictory demand signals emerged for diamonds, spanning reported export factory shutdowns alongside claims of pre-Diwali revival.
Textile manufacturers make early strategic inroads into technical textiles and defence fabrics despite local operating headwinds.
stress_signals: Textile sector faces power cuts, higher electricity costs, and an estimated Rs 300 crore weekly loss across Gujarat [385f9b90ae46, 37c492915105].

Pre-Diwali diamond unit default (uthamnu) involving crores, alongside over ₹20 lakh in unpaid wages for 20 artisans and union demands for overdue bonuses/overtime [8f729a2b282e, 402ab705574d, c8a89bd2019b].
US demand slump triggering dried-up orders and factory closures for diamond and apparel exporters, while textile units confront labor shortages and weak domestic demand [caa34a6cf84e, 0bc3ac5bf041].
Operational and trade credit risks highlighted by a broker-led fabric delivery fraud of Rs 1.69 crore and a Pandesara unit fire causing ₹1 crore in damage [25d6a0f6dbec, dba1533f8fd5].
improvement_signals: Surat diamond sector reportedly sees a pre-Diwali demand resurgence, while gem exporters work to rebuild US ties and diversify markets [01cb30b63e0d, 37e6ab2a18cd].
ICA GemLab established an international-standard gemological testing and certification facility in Surat [4ae73fd1a2f2].
Cluster diversification into technical textiles via MANTRA's exploration with Mercedes-Benz and local expansion into defence fabrics [3a4ce1852d7c, c4aec155608f].
what_to_watch: Account-level utility bills, generator fuel expenses, and plant operating days to assess margin erosion from power cuts and tariff hikes.
Post-Diwali cash flow patterns, payroll clearing, and debtor recoveries among diamond polishing MSMEs following broker fraud and default reports.
Occupancy, trading volume uptake, and member relocation developments at the Surat Diamond Bourse.
Potential capital outflows or capex diversion by local textile players targeted by the IMT Sohna investment promotion.
